text: Analytical-detail revision: the stored within-detection count-versus-design log-loss, AUC, and AP intervals favor counts although its Brier interval spans zero. This counterbalances an overly compressed summary. The same result exports supply the expanded main text and appendix; these are correlated, exploratory metrics rather than independent replications.
